Delhi sets new eligibility criteria for EV subsidies

The Delhi government has established technical eligibility standards for electric vehicle (EV) models to receive purchase incentives under its EV Policy-2026. These new guidelines specify that EV models with a warranty of less than three years will not qualify for subsidies. This move aims to refine the policy and potentially encourage manufacturers to offer longer warranties.
